title: Prepare the local bootstrap base for first self-use
description: Satisfy the two operator-owned prerequisites for the first live Yoyodyne run: authenticate the installed Claude Code CLI with the intended Claude Max account, and commit the reviewed Milestone 0 product implementation so it is an immutable worktree base. Beads may subsequently modify only its two explicitly allowed control-plane JSONL exports.
design: This is an operational bootstrap prerequisite, not a product approval or routine integration gate. Yoyodyne must continue refusing to claim agent work when provider authentication is absent or the primary checkout is dirty.
acceptance_criteria: claude auth status --json reports loggedIn=true; the reviewed Milestone 0 implementation is committed; any post-commit primary-checkout changes are limited to .beads/interactions.jsonl and .beads/issues.jsonl; after this prerequisite is closed, go run ./cmd/yoyodyne run --json yoyodyne-ifd.2.1 proceeds past preflight.

title: Add the canonical Go build entry point
description: Add a dependency-free Makefile that gives operators and agents stable build, test, race, vet, and aggregate check commands before the bootstrap commit.
design: Use standard Make and the Go toolchain only. Keep individual verification targets composable so Yoyodyne can report deterministic checks separately. Build the CLI into the ignored bin directory.
acceptance_criteria: make check runs test, race, and vet successfully; make build creates bin/yoyodyne; .yoyodyne.yaml invokes stable Make targets; generated binaries are ignored; direct Go commands remain available.

title: Add the provider-neutral structured review verdict
description: Implement the smallest Milestone 1 building block from docs/v1-harness-design.md: a provider-neutral structured reviewer verdict model and strict JSON decoding/validation. This is the first intended Yoyodyne self-use item.
design: Keep review semantics outside provider adapters. Represent an approve-or-repair decision, a concise summary, and zero or more actionable findings with severity, message, and optional file/line location. Reject unknown fields, invalid decisions or severities, empty required text, repair verdicts without findings, and trailing JSON. Bound input size. Do not yet invoke a reviewer or change the run pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: A focused internal package exposes the validated review-verdict types and bounded strict decoder; table-driven tests cover approval, repair with actionable findings, malformed/trailing/oversized JSON, unknown fields, invalid enum values, missing text, invalid locations, and repair without findings; go test ./... and go vet ./... pass.
notes: Sequencing note: this first Milestone 1 building block is temporarily parented under the Milestone 0 bootstrap gate so Yoyodyne can execute it before Milestone 0 closes; its implementation still belongs to the structured-review portion of Milestone 1.

title: Add process runner, normalized events, and durable run state
description: Implement the provider-neutral process/event foundation for Milestone 0, including correlation IDs, normalized event envelopes, external state directories, atomic state writes, cancellation, timeouts, and interrupted-run discovery.
design: Runtime state stays outside the repository. Process execution and clocks are injectable for deterministic tests. Provider-specific parsers emit the shared event model.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover successful, failed, cancelled, timed-out, malformed, and interrupted runs; state writes are atomic; secrets are not persisted; restart discovery identifies active or incomplete runs without duplicating them.
notes: Implemented internal/execution normalized event schema, sequencing, redaction, streaming subprocess runner, cancellation/timeout/exit classification, and bounded output; implemented internal/runstate IDs, external state-root resolution, validated state lifecycle, atomic replacement, duplicate prevention, event JSONL, and incomplete-run discovery. Focused normal/race tests and vet pass.
close_reason: Completed provider-neutral process/events and durable recoverable run state with passing normal/race tests and vet.

title: Implement the single-item yoyodyne run pipeline
description: Compose configuration, Beads, worktree, context, state, Claude backend, and deterministic checks behind yoyodyne run <beads-id>.
design: Use an explicit orchestration state machine with idempotent durable transitions. Milestone 0 preserves the completed branch and reports it for external integration; it does not pretend independent review or automatic integration exists.
acceptance_criteria: A fake-backed end-to-end test claims one item, creates an isolated worktree, applies a change, runs configured checks, records outcome state, updates Beads, and reports the branch/diff/result; failures remain diagnosable and resumable.
notes:
Implemented yoyodyne run <beads-id> composition across config, Beads, bounded context, owned Git worktrees, durable state/events, Claude Code, deterministic checks, cancellation, machine-readable output, and bounded Git change summaries. Fake-backed end-to-end tests use a real temporary Git repository/worktree and cover success, provider failure preservation, auth refusal, and duplicate-run refusal. Full go test, race, vet, build, config validation, and diff checks pass.
Final handoff hardening added mechanical rejection of developer-created commits, exact base-commit and provider-session persistence, explicit blocked-item readiness validation before claim, and an integration test proving an atomic Beads claim may update only the two allowed control-plane JSONL files while all product-file dirt remains rejected. Full normal/race/vet suite remains green.
close_reason: Completed and fully validated the single-item bootstrap run pipeline and CLI.

title: Verify the first Yoyodyne self-use run
description: Exercise the completed Milestone 0 pipeline on a small bounded Yoyodyne implementation issue and record the branch, diff, event log, checks, and Beads outcome.
design: Use a harmless task whose expected result is easy to inspect. Integration remains external during this bootstrap run; the resulting evidence gates Milestone 1 handoff.
acceptance_criteria: The command yoyodyne run <beads-id> completes against Yoyodyne itself, configured Go checks pass, durable run artifacts are discoverable, and the produced change is suitable for external bootstrap integration.
notes:
Live CLI preflight on yoyodyne-ifd.2.1 was attempted with the built binary. Yoyodyne correctly refused before claim or state creation because Claude Code 2.1.222 reports loggedIn=false/authMethod=none. The primary repository also contains the intentionally uncommitted Milestone 0 bootstrap implementation and must be reviewed and committed before isolated worktree creation. Operational prerequisite is tracked as yoyodyne-ifd.5.8.
Final executable-level audit used an authenticated Claude CLI stub only for preflight and confirmed the live Beads graph blocks solely on yoyodyne-ifd.5.8, without claim or run-state creation. The real Claude conformance check still skips with installed=true/loggedIn=false. Full go test, race, vet, build, config validation, git diff check, and bd lint pass after final hardening.

title: Add Beads adapter and bounded context assembly
description: Implement a narrow bd CLI adapter for reading, claiming, updating, blocking, and recording outcomes for one item, plus context assembly from the item and explicitly referenced repository Markdown.
design: Raw bd JSON remains inside the adapter. Context assembly is bounded and deterministic; it does not crawl arbitrary project history. Beads remains the durable workflow source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter tests use a fake command runner; context tests cover referenced files, missing or escaping paths, size limits, and deterministic ordering; one ready item can be claimed and updated through the domain interface.
notes: Implemented typed internal/beads client for show, atomic claim, append-only outcome notes, dependency blockers, and completion; raw bd JSON is confined to the adapter. Implemented deterministic bounded context assembly from work items and explicit Markdown references with missing, traversal, symlink-escape, regular-file, and byte-limit checks. Focused normal/race tests and vet pass.
close_reason: Completed typed Beads workflow adapter and secure deterministic bounded context assembly with passing tests and vet.

title: Add the Claude Code developer backend
description: Implement availability/auth diagnostics and non-interactive structured execution for the Milestone 0 developer role, including event parsing, session ID capture where available, cancellation, exit classification, and final outcome extraction.
design: Claude-specific flags and event shapes stay in the backend adapter. Prompts are supplied without shell interpolation, credentials remain provider-managed, and the adapter advertises explicit capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture and fake-process tests cover structured success, tool activity, malformed events, provider errors, cancellation, and missing CLI; an opt-in local conformance test can run without becoming part of deterministic CI.
notes: Implemented provider-neutral backend contract and Claude Code adapter using -p, stream-json, verbose events, explicit permission/tool policy, stdin prompts, session resume, local auth/version diagnostics, event normalization, bounded payloads, cancellation, provider error classification, and fixture/fake-process tests. Normal/race tests and vet pass. Opt-in local conformance correctly detects installed Claude Code 2.1.222 but skips because claude auth status reports loggedIn=false/authMethod=none.
close_reason: Completed and tested the Claude Code developer backend; live conformance is available and currently reports the external CLI login prerequisite.

title: Bootstrap Go CLI, configuration, and domain foundation
description: Create the Go module and first executable slice for Milestone 0: command dispatch, machine-readable output, strict .yoyodyne.yaml loading, core product/agent/backend/approval types, and invariant validation.
design: Keep the CLI thin over internal packages. Use stable domain types and strict configuration decoding. Permit the reduced Milestone 0 developer-only configuration while validating backend capability restrictions and automatic-integration prerequisites when configured.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./... and go vet ./... pass; the binary provides help and version output; config validate accepts a valid developer-only bootstrap config, rejects unknown fields and invalid invariants, and can emit JSON.
notes: Implemented go.mod, cmd/yoyodyne, internal/domain, internal/config, internal/cli, and the repository bootstrap .yoyodyne.yaml. Validation: go test ./..., go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., go build ./cmd/yoyodyne, go test -cover ./..., live config validate --json, git diff --check, and trailing-whitespace scan all pass. Installed Go 1.26.6 via Homebrew because no Go toolchain was present.
close_reason: Completed the tested Go CLI, strict configuration, and core domain foundation; all acceptance checks pass.

title: Add validated Git branch and worktree management
description: Implement branch/worktree creation, inspection, preservation, and cleanup for one assigned run, with managed roots outside the primary checkout and strict path validation.
design: The harness owns all Git lifecycle operations. Every mutating or cleanup action resolves a recorded exact path and rejects repository roots, broad paths, symlink escapes, and unowned worktrees.
acceptance_criteria: Temporary-repository tests cover create, reuse refusal, dirty target detection, branch naming, preserved failure state, safe cleanup, and rejection of unsafe or unresolved paths.
notes: Implemented internal/gitworktree manager with canonical root validation, dirty-primary refusal, deterministic owned branch/path naming, branch/path reuse checks, registered worktree verification, inspection, preserved dirty failures, integration ancestry checks, and exact safe cleanup. Temporary-repository normal/race tests and vet pass.
close_reason: Completed strict harness-owned Git branch/worktree lifecycle with safe preservation and cleanup; tests and vet pass.

title: Add the thin Codex developer and reviewer backend
description: Implement Milestone 5 from docs/v1-harness-design.md: Codex CLI availability/auth diagnostics, codex exec JSONL normalization, supported session resumption, structured outcomes, sandbox mapping, capability validation, and conformance tests.
design: Do not pursue full Claude/Codex feature parity or direct API integration in v1. Credentials remain managed by the local Codex CLI.
acceptance_criteria: A developer or reviewer agent may select Codex in configuration and complete the common run protocol; unsupported roles or policies fail validation; Claude Code remains the default backend for all roles.

title: Bootstrap the developer walking skeleton
description: Implement Milestone 0 from docs/v1-harness-design.md: Go CLI and config, Beads adapter, validated worktree manager, process/event runner, Claude Code developer backend, bounded context assembly, deterministic checks, and recoverable run summary.
design: Use narrow interfaces for Beads, Git, process execution, and agent backends. This is the only milestone expected to be implemented entirely outside Yoyodyne.
acceptance_criteria: Yoyodyne can claim one of its own ready Beads items, create an isolated worktree, run Claude Code on it, execute configured checks, and preserve the branch, diff, event log, and durable outcome for external bootstrap integration.

title: Add configurable management roles and CLI UX
description: Implement Milestone 3 from docs/v1-harness-design.md: product-manager chat, architect, development manager, configurable role definitions, durable logical identities with ephemeral provider processes, targeted agent interaction, and administrative commands.
design: Keep role authority distinct from backend mechanics and reconstruct each execution context from durable project state.
acceptance_criteria: The operator can discuss the brief and goals with the product manager, address any configured agent, inspect durable agent and work state, and have designs decomposed into governed Beads work through the default role hierarchy.

title: Add scheduler and concurrent worktrees
description: Implement Milestone 4 from docs/v1-harness-design.md: ready-work scheduling, configurable developer concurrency, isolated worktrees, integration ordering, and cross-task conflict handling.
design: The scheduler must respect Beads dependencies, unresolved directives, artifact revisions, worktree leases, and integration serialization.
acceptance_criteria: The harness can run multiple eligible developer tasks concurrently in harness-owned worktrees, honors a configurable concurrency limit that defaults to one, and never force-integrates conflicting or stale changes.

title: Add product artifact governance
description: Implement Milestone 2 from docs/v1-harness-design.md: stable artifact IDs, relationship validation, ownership enforcement, change proposals, staleness propagation, directive reconciliation, configurable approvals, and Yoyodyne's own seeded product artifacts.
design: Repository Markdown owns artifact content; Beads owns workflow, links, directives, approvals, blockers, and handoff state.
acceptance_criteria: The harness validates brief-to-goal-to-design-to-work traceability, rejects unauthorized upstream edits, pauses affected work for ambiguous or artifact-changing directives, and records default human approval for the initial brief and goals.

title: Close the automatic self-hosting loop
description: Implement Milestone 1 from docs/v1-harness-design.md using the walking skeleton: independent review, structured verdicts, two-attempt repair, automatic conflict-aware integration, cleanup, restart reconciliation, duplicate-run prevention, and end-to-end fakes.
design: Build this milestone through the Milestone 0 harness wherever the walking skeleton is capable. Integration remains blocked unless checks and independent review succeed.
acceptance_criteria: Yoyodyne can implement, check, independently review, repair, and automatically integrate a bounded change to its own repository without routine human approval, and an interrupted run can be safely reconciled.

title: Build Yoyodyne v1 through early self-hosting
description: Implement the v1 harness described in docs/v1-harness-design.md. Reach the first self-use threshold after the walking skeleton, close the automatic review/integration loop next, and use the harness for suitable remaining milestones.
design: Implementation follows the milestone sequence in the design document. Each child milestone must preserve the design invariants and leave durable outcomes in Beads. Bootstrap work is manual only until the harness can safely execute its own bounded tasks.
acceptance_criteria: The v1 workflow supports governed product artifacts, configurable roles, local Claude execution, optional thin Codex developer/reviewer execution, isolated concurrent worktrees with a default limit of one, deterministic checks, independent review, repair and replan, and automatic integration without routine human approval.

title: Design Yoyodyne v1 self-hosting agent harness
description: Capture the agreed v1 product model, artifact governance, configurable agent roles, Claude Code and thin Codex integration, Beads persistence, worktree isolation, automatic review/integration, failure handling, and an implementation sequence that lets Yoyodyne develop itself as early as practical.
design: The design is a tracked repository document. Sequence a minimal vertical slice first: durable task plus one developer backend plus isolated worktree plus deterministic verification, then use that slice to implement later capabilities under supervised self-hosting.
acceptance_criteria: A repository design document records the agreed behavior and architecture; responsibilities and authority boundaries are explicit; persistence boundaries are explicit; the initial implementation milestones identify the self-hosting threshold and distinguish bootstrap code from harness-built code; open questions are identified without blocking the agreed v1 design.
close_reason: Created and validated docs/v1-harness-design.md, including the early self-hosting sequence, and mirrored implementation into Beads epic yoyodyne-ifd with dependent milestone issues.
